nom: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hydrating Facial Cleansing Gel

avis.texte: My daughter left her partially used bottle at my house several years ago, so I thought I'd give this a try. …this is now the only product I use to cleanse my face. Leaves my skin fresh and clean…never any irritation, never dry. Along with a good moisturizer, this is the only product needed to keep my skin looking healthy.
This Neutrogena Hidro Boost whit Hialuronic Acid is hydrating.Gently cleanses and effectively removes dirt,oil,and makeup while increasing skin's hidratation.

avis.titre: Best Gel Cleanser for dry skin!
avis.texte: I have used the hydro boost MOISTURIZERs for several years now and many other products in the hydro boost line and i am TOTALLY in love with this cleanser and it smells amazing! Its the first gel cleanser ever that does not strip my skin!
Love this cleanser so much! All the products from neutrogena are a staple in my skincare routine! This cleanser gives you a clean and hydrated skin.

avis.titre: Good product but not for sensitive skin
avis.texte: Have tried this product, Neutrogena is not a good fit for me , have had reactions to their products in the past, but this one is okay , did not cause any issue, face feels clean , it does lather a lot more ,also cause it acts as a makeup remover, but otherwise it cleans off well

It is an excellent cleansing gel that does not irritate the skin and effectively removes oil and dirt. It is easy to apply, and a small amount produces enough foam to wash the entire face. The face is left feeling dry and clean.

This cleansing gel is moisturizing and removes makeup with easy. It glides easily across the face and you only need a little bit. The bottle lasts a long time and the price is extremely affordable. Neutrogena is a great brand and their products are the definition of quality. I highly recommend this product and checking out the other products they have.
Love this cleanser for the cold, dry months. Keeps my skin hydrated & feeling plump. Doesnt irritate my skin or break me out. Affordable and long lasting cleanser!

I have been using this product for several years. Doesn't require a lot. Cleans well. Face feels hydrated. But I do not care for new packaging. I keep turning top to pump and it doesn't pop up. Thankfully I kept old bottle. Just poured content into old bottle.
my mom loves this! Definitely not such a budget-friendly item, but its worth the money. no breakouts. no residue. feels smooth to the touch. its amazing.

I have combo/oily skin that can feel tight after washing. Skin feels clean but still soft and hydrated no dry tightness at all. Lathers up lightly with a bit of water, rinses easy, and doesn't leave residue. I massage a small amount on wet face for a quick wash, and even in winter it keeps things balanced if I follow with moisturizer.

Not my favorite but it's still good. It doesn't remove makeup very well and even after washing a few times there's still residue on my face. I don't find this to be super hydrating either but it's good in a pinch

avis.titre: Gentle, Hydrating, and Easy Makeup Removal
avis.texte: I've been using this cleansing gel and makeup remover for a while, and I really like it. It removes makeup easily, leaves my skin soft and not tight. It's not greasy and keeps my skin hydrated- perfect for everyday use.

avis.titre: I love the glow it gives my skin
avis.texte: Leave my skin so clean and so soft, does not irritate does not hurt I like its soft texture My face looks brighter and cleaner ideal for all skin types since it does not hurt the skin

The cleansing gel feels incredibly refreshing light, hydrating, and it never leaves my skin feeling tight or dry. It creates a smooth lather that melts away dirt and sunscreen effortlessly, and I love that it boosts hydration at the same time. If you're looking for gentle, effective cleansing that keeps your skin hydrated and fresh, I can't recommend these enough!

This cleansing gel feels so refreshing on the skin. It removes makeup really well without leaving my face dry or tight. I love that it's oil-free and has hyaluronic acid—my skin always feels soft and hydrated after using it. Gentle, effective, and perfect for everyday use!

The first time I bought this cleanser I was blown away by how clean it felt and how moisturized my skin still felt after using it, rather than being stripped. Something clearly must have changed - I bought it again, and it has a horrific artificial fragrance and feels *much* more drying. I can't find any information online about a reformulation and some sites even try to claim this is still fragrance free, but the change is so clear and it's a massive disappointment. Time to try something else, I guess.

✨ I recently tried the Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hydrating Gel Cleanser, and I absolutely love it! The gel texture feels very light and refreshing on the skin. It cleanses thoroughly, removing dirt, oil, and makeup without leaving my face feeling dry or tight. Instead, my skin feels soft, smooth, and hydrated thanks to the hyaluronic acid. It's gentle enough for daily use, and I've noticed my skin looks more radiant and moisturized. I highly recommend this cleanser for anyone looking for effective cleansing with a boost of hydration!

it's a reliable everyday cleanser that hydrates while cleaning, making it a great option for most normal to combination skin types. For very dry or skin with specific conditions, you might need a richer alternative or an additional moisturizing step.
Please stop getting rid of these products!! I CANNOT FIND this anywhere, it works amazing, doesnt burn, and cleans so well.

avis.titre: Leave your skin feeling hydrated, firm and glowing
avis.texte: I've used Neutrogena Hydro Boost cleansing gel and makeup remover for quite a while now. The texture and ingredients make it well worth using for a very long time as I have found it is better and more natural then department store Woods three times the price. Comes with a light sense it leaves your skin feeling smooth, hydrated and luminescent. One of my favorite daily Beauty rituals!

avis.titre: Effective hydration boost to remove impurities
avis.texte: It's incredible, it removes your makeup, even mascara, which is the hardest part. It leaves your skin hydrated and contains hyaluronic acid. I love the product.

This cleanser feels light and refreshing on the skin. It lathers into a soft gel that removes dirt, oil, and most makeup without leaving the face tight or dry. Since it's oil-free and contains hyaluronic acid, it gives a clean but hydrated feel, making it great for daily use, especially on normal to combination skin.

avis.titre: This item is very effective in removing impurities
avis.texte: I love Neutrogena hydro boost ! Has a very nice scent . It's vey effective in cleansing your complexion. The texture is gentle yet very effective in removing impurities. I love the presentation of the item .
This Hydro Boost with Hyaluronic acid Gel Cleanser by Neutrogena is my go-to face cleanser. It leaves my face feeling soft and clean. It has a very clean scent to it.

TLDR: NO, BAD AND HARMFUL, GET ANYTHING ELSE, I am now confident neutragena products are all worthless First of all: neutragena, you have failed me time and again with products that boast claims that are either impossible to achieve with the actual ingredients or have the complete opposite effect. I have been burned by choosing to trust advancing forumulations from this brand so many times. Y'all should be ashamed of yourselves for selling this to people, a product that is practically heavily scented dish soap. It is absolutely ridiculous to put the word hydrating on this product and tell people it is safe to put on your face. Shame on you! Enjoy never getting my money again & seeing the impact of your awful formulations on your shrinking sales charts from everyone else realizing they can literally get almost any other facial cleanser on the market and have a better experience. Want to listen to my feedback? Develop better formulas and listen to the scientists in your lab (god I hope there are scientists) when they say one is awful After a few uses on my face I realized this cleanser is incredibly stripping. It left me with that alarming "squeaky clean" noise on both face and body skin. After max 4 uses this caused my face to peel and a giant wound to open after continued use past that. And I only continued using because this was my only option, at this point I might throw it away. I would never repurchase this cleanser, even for body acne. I would highly recommend researchin

avis.titre: Yes to Refill pouch, Hydroboost face wash
avis.texte: I really like this face wash that makes my skin feel nice and easily washes away makeup. However, i cannot find the refill pouches in stores or online. Is it discontinued? I bought the pouches rsther than buying more plastic bottles every time i finished the product. I have one in the shower and one at the face sink. It is so annoying to throw a plastic bottle away and have to replace it with yet another PLASTIC bottle. The refill pouch is very easy to use and far less pastic waste. Bring back the refill pouch!

I use this wash every single night. I usually use micellar water to take off my eye makeup and then I cleanse my full face with this. I have sensitive skin and this is very gentle. I love how they sell it in different sizes so I have the large pump one. Super easy to use and one pump is all I need to clean my face at night

This product is 1000/100 recommended! I personally would recommend this product for anyone with sensitive skin! The texture is amazing leaving you with BABY soft skin!!! The scent is very minimal which is good for people who have reactions with fragrance in products!
My favorite cleanser and makeup remover. It's gentle yet effective. Great packaging to travel with. It has ingredients to help hydrate skin as well
This is just alright. I like how it is gentle on my skin, but it didn't really do much for me. Probably great for sensitive skin as it is unscented and gentle.

avis.titre: "Neutrogena Hydro Boost Cleansing Gel has sleek pa
avis.texte: "Neutrogena has sleek packaging, a fresh scent, lightweight gel texture, and effectively removes makeup while hydrating without oiliness"

Love how this Hydro Boost 2‑in‑1 cleansing gel + oil‑free makeup remover feels ✨. It's guilt-free—soap- and oil‑free, fragrance‑free, and just pure hydration. The gel turns into a silky foam that lifts off makeup and grime yet leaves the skin soft and quenched (thanks, hyaluronic acid!). I've noticed my skin no longer feels tight after washing. Instead, it's calm, clean, and always feels balanced. Doesn't clog pores. Doesn't break me out. Even removes eye makeup with ease, without any stinging or irritation. The pump bottle is super convenient too. And the best part? It's super affordable—especially compared to high-end makeup removers or cleansers—yet gives the luxury feel of something more expensive. Absolute staple in my routine, especially for dry or sensitive skin 💧.

I had purchased a balm product to take off makeup and waterproof mascara but then I had to use another product to wash off residue from the balm. Decided to try this for removing stubborn makeup at the end of the day and it does work better than the balm insofar as it washes off more cleanly without so much effort. I did not use it around my eyes, not sure about waterproof mascara.

I like this face wash a lot!! I don't use it daily but it's great for when I feel like my skin is getting extra dry because it's very hydrating, I also have no problem with it breaking me out. Definitely recommend to anyone with really dry skin!

avis.titre: Cleanses face really well without stripping away
avis.texte: I tried this cleanser because someone here in Influenster mentioned how good it was for combination skin. I have been using this for a couple months now and I absolutely love it. It is very gentle on the skin. My skin tens to dry out pretty quickly if the face wash is not nice. This helps maintain that natural oil balance on the skin. It's very gentle while it strips away the dirt and makeup really well. Also a small amount goes a long way. And the best part is that it is fragrance free which i love for skincare products
Takes your makeup off and smooth the skin, highly recommend and it's not too expensive and would totally recommend this to any new and not looking for any harsh chemicals on their face
This cleanser feels super gentle but still removes all my makeup, even waterproof mascara. My skin feels clean and hydrated, not tight or dry after using it. Love the light, fresh scent too!
I have very oily skin especially in the summer I just switch to this for my cleanser and my skin is staying cleaner longer .it leave my face feeling clean and refreshed .

avis.titre: Refreshing cleanser snd smooth gel like feel
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using this product! I wanted one that felt easy and lightweight to use and because it's a gel it goes on smoothly and isn't too oily or slimy feeling! It smells refreshing and it comes in a good size tube for long use!

I have used the Neutrogena Hydro Boost Cleansing Gel and Oil-Free Makeup Remover consistently, and it has been a great addition to my skincare routine. It removes all traces of makeup, including foundation and waterproof mascara, without stripping my skin. The texture is lightweight and smooth, and it lathers just enough to feel refreshing. I appreciate that it contains hyaluronic acid, which helps my skin feel soft and hydrated after each use. There is no greasy residue, and it does not cause any irritation or breakouts. Overall, it feels gentle yet effective.
All Neutrogena products are amazing but this cleanser is phenomenal. Packaging is great. It lasts a long time. Amazing process point. Smells refreshing and very effective.

I love this makeup remover, it's really moisturizing with hyaluronic acid. I use it to remove makeup without irritating my skin. The price is affordable and the travel size is great to take anywhere. I don't smell any fragrance, which is a plus for me.

avis.titre: Good deep cleaning cleanser for the face!
avis.texte: Great facial cleanser for when you need a deeper scrub. This cleanser foams up nicely and feels like it's really getting deep into the skin. I use this whenever I need a deeper scrub clean. Not to mention it smells good as well, unlike many other cleaners!
I got a sample size of this and I liked it so much I went and bought the full size. It has a very clean fragrance and it feels like it cleanses your skin really well, with no irritation.

Not the worst exfoliating cleanser, but far from my favorite. I tried this when my local store was out of my preferred Olay exfoliating cleaner and I was disappointed. It does make your face feel more hydrated, as promised, but I've never felt it exfoliated well. The size of the bottle is priced well, and it has a nice scent, but I likely will not buy again because of how poor the exfoliation experience is. I would rather spend more money on a smaller size bottle that does a better job.
This face cleaner is great. It takes off all my make up the first time and it smells great also.
I've been using this cleanser for a long time and let me tell you it's worked wonders for my skin I love it ❤️!!!!!
It cleans well and leaves the skin feeling fresh and moisturized. A little goes a long way. Love that it comes in a pump.
Use this face wash every day. Leaves my face feeling soft and hydrated. Little to no scent. The texture is great. It gets all my makeup off no problem without irritation.
Typical packaging, but the cap could be hard to open sometimes when your hands are wet. It did clean my face, but it leaves some kind of greasy film after. Foaming is minimal. Very subtle scent.
I love this cleanser. It lathers up really nice. It's very effective. The packaging is good. There's no harsh ingredients. It has a clean scent.

This does a pretty good job at removing my makeup. There aren't any harsh scents that could irritate my skin. The squeeze bottle makes it easy to get product out. I do usually have to double cleanse to remove 100% of my makeup, but that's pretty typical in my experience.

avis.titre: Great face wash for a great price
avis.texte: I like my Neutrogena face wash because it is a simple product that takes care of all my needs when it comes to cleansing my face. It is efficient in taking off my make up as well as washes my face on a daily basis. I use another product for double cleansing as needed, but most of the times this face wash is enough for me. The price is also reasonable.

I truly admire this brand, not only for its elegantly designed packaging but also for the beautifully subtle yet impactful fragrance it offers. The texture is delightfully lightweight, making it a pleasure to use.

I just found out they make a fragrance free version BUY THAT ONE. The amount of fragrance in this makes washing my face a nightmare it stings my eyes and I have to hold my breath the whole time so i dont choke on the scent. However, it doesnt break me out and its quite hydrating for the winter months so itll do for now
I've been using this product for quite some time now. very pleased with cleaning my phase and not drying it. Real soft skin after feel too. Will definitely keep on buying again.

avis.titre: Love this for cleaning my face
avis.texte: This cleansing gel is very nice because it makes my face feel very smooth and hydrated. It effectively removes makeup and impurities. I feel like Neutrogena is a good quality brand. This hydrating cleansing gel is so free oil free and is a very good product. It has a slight scent that is not strong. To use it you wet your face and apply a small amount to your hands working to a lather and then wash your face gently. Rinse off and pat dry with a towel. I do this in the morning and the night.
Lightly made, no oil residue or flaking after using. Lightly scented but not overpowering or anything like that. My skin has never been more hydrated
I love Neutrogena products they are my everyday cleansers and moisturizer. I love how they clean without drying out my skin. And the hydroboost really does leave my skin feeling hydrated.

I bought this product with a completely clear face, 0 breakouts. I haven't had any issues with breakouts in months. I have combination skin and I was just looking for a good hydrating cleanser to use as we move into the colder months - thinking this would help hence the name. Upon day 2 to 3 of use my face began to break out horribly! I attributed this to the "purge" phase, and continued use. This was the WORST mistake I could've made because it has only gotten so so much worse! I'm devastated. I will also add that there is really nothing hydrating about the product either. I'm not sure what I was expecting, but I do know that this product falls way below even the most basic cheap cleansers. I believe they really bombed on this one. I've never had a product be so opposite of it's uses and claims - to the point that it reversed the quality of my skin and actually caused harm.

It's a nice travel size cleanser I wouldn't personally use for everyday use but it will get the job done and it is super gentle. It's a clear formula that doesn't really foam up and does have a slight scent.

Im 33 and I've been using Neutrogena products most of my life. My skin is dry most of the time, but moistures leave it oily. This is a great solution to keeping my skin feeling clean and moisturized. Love the lite lite scent to.

I'm obsessed with this cleanser! It's super gentle on my skin and leaves it feeling so fresh and moisturized. The formula is perfect, it removes everything without stripping my skin. I actually don't mind the scent—it's fresh and gives spa day vibes. I've repurchased several times because for the price you really can't beat it. If you have dry/combo skin this will be your go-to.
I love this cleanser . My skin is so soft and smooth. PEOPLE tell me how good my skin looks all the time . After using this cleanser i use the neutrogena GENTLE MOISTURIZEr . Thank me later!

I just love this cleanser,It has been my go to cleansers from past 4years. I swear by it. It has a subtle fragrance which makes the morning refreshing.The packaging is so sturdy and it has good ingredients which cleanses without stripping the oils on skin.

Sensitive and middle age skin approved! I have combination oily/dry skin and this is a one stop cleanser that leaves my face feeling super clean, hydrated, and soft. No harsh additives or scents that harm your skin. Just a simple one step clean!
For my sensitive skin it's a hazard. It provoked acne and irritation. It is too hard for my skin type. Skin becomes more sensitive and dry after a week of using.

This is my favorite face wash. I use it regularly. I like the gels consistency and the little beads in it. The beads aren't overwhelming to where it feels like sand. Leaves my face super soft!! It just smells clean, not any overwhelming scent.

avis.titre: This cleansing gel hydrates and cleanses skin, leaving it...
avis.texte: The Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Facial Gel transforms into a rich, foamy lather upon contact with water. This foaming action not only feels luxurious but also ensures a deep and thorough cleanse. The foam rinses off easily, leaving the skin feeling refreshed and clean.

avis.titre: This product is well suited for normal skin
avis.texte: I really liked the face gel, it washes off the makeup well and then the face becomes fresh and clean. It doesn't dry my skin, which is the most important thing for me.
My go to cleanser. Glides on smooth and really cleans up the makeup residue. I get a good clean refreshed wash every time that leaves my skin hydrated and happy.

I was given a sample of this by a dermatologist and loved it. I bought what I thought was the same face wash from the drug store only to find out that the new formula has fragrance. I have sensitive skin and do not use products with fragrance. I feel like this was a bit of a bate and switch. I loved the sample the dermatologist off but hate this new formula with fragrance. I find this very drying for my skin.
This is probably my favorite cleanser!! It has such a clean, light scent with a great texture. It moisturizes your face, leaving a smooth, glossy finish to the skin. I love it.

My sister loved this cleanser (and lotion) so much she actually gifted it to me with my birthday gift. I've used it for a while now and can say I equally love it. It removes my makeup without harshly stripping my skin of natural oils. The texture is perfect. Great for sensitive skin. Highly recommend!

This cleansing gel is really hydrating, it is a gentle cleanser so if you have dry skin this would be perfect, it's ok but I have oily skin and I like my skin to feel super clean, I don't want my face to still feel like it has something on it and that is the feeling this gives me, I like for the oils to be remove off my face, for my skin to be really clean, that's just what I like, it has no smell which is nice if you prefer that, I will use this as my second cleanser after going with a cleanser that I actually feel like takes all the gunk, the day off my face but the 4 stars stand because it's not bad, I just prefer a cleanser that takes the day off my face.
It wasn't my favorite but I liked it enough. It's great for travel but I don't think I'd use this everyday. It smells fine and I like the gel consistency.

avis.titre: One of the best out here!!
avis.texte: Very good cleansing gel I must say ..I've been using this brand for along time now & I have seen such a improvement. Does not irritate your skin at all…and the price of this stuff is unbelievable. Will definitely keep using.
I loved this face wash. It smells so good & clean. Its not too thick & it lathers so good. It makes my skin so so smooth & soft & it doesn't dry out my skin at all.
This is my go to wash after a full face of makeup. It doesn't load on more as I'm trying to cleanse stuff off of that makes sense. It's a great makeup cleanser, very lightweight.
I tried this face wash once and it was good. It was soft and light and it didn't make my face feel tight. It was unscented which I prefer. It wasn't too good at removing eye makeup.

I bought this product thinking it would benefit my skin (face) because I use neutrogena products and have for years, I love them. This however is not for me! I have sensitive skin and this product gave me massive chemical burns. I had a red face for a few days and could not figure out why until it clicked, I started using a new product on my face, this one. Once I stopped and went back to my other products my face cleared of the redness, burn, and my skin was back to normal once I stopped using it. Not saying it won't work for you, but use caution it may cause irritation, redness and burn. I hope they fix this product, I love most neutrogena products, unfortunately, not this one.

avis.titre: Excellent and mild eye makeup remover.
avis.texte: Great mascara can be almost impossible to remove. This did the trick without being heavy and stinging. Very little scent, easy to use, and mild but effective,

avis.titre: Say hello to fresh looking skin!
avis.texte: The Neutrogena Hydro boost cleaning gel and oil free make up remover is a very effective face wash for people who use make up regularly. I used this regularly and I have noticed that my skin looks fresh, clean and brighter after every use. The scent is very very mild and barely noticeable. It works well with all skin types and cleans the pores thoroughly! A must have in my skin care routine!
I like this it definitely makes your face feel fresh and clean. I use it probably 1-3 times a week because I do wear makeup a lot so I do feel like it takes off all the dirt and makeup off my face
Most cleansers can't take off makeup like this powerhouse. It's my go-to for getting a full face off at the end of the day

It's nothing special. It cleans your face, suds up a lot and that's about it. It didn't feel very hydrating and left my face a little tight. I don't like that it has fragrance either but that's a personal preference.

I love this so much. I got it for free from someone and I used it all the time. It made my skin feel so smooth and nice and It was the best cleanser i've ever used. It foams up a little but not too much which is great. And it smells really really good. I love this stuff with all my heart. I stopped using it just because I ran out and couldn't find the big version but I will be repurchasing.
It's a gentle cleanser for sure, but something in this gave me an atopic dermatitis flare-up (eczema) that was really hard to shift.
Very efficient cleansing make up remover. Does not dry the skin and doesn't irritate the skin. Light scent and convenient packaging where you can get all the last drops of product

avis.titre: As good as any pricey/deluxe cleanser on the market
avis.texte: I've tried quite a few different cleansers over the years. Some in the same price point as Neutrogena and others four times the price. I keep coming back to Neutrogena Hydro Boost Cleanser though. It doesn't have an overpowering smell and my face feels clean and refreshed after each use. Why waste your money on other brands?
I love all the Hydro Boost line of products, from the face wash to the water gel cream, the smell is heavenly. The creaminess of this melts into your skin and is very hydrating.

Although I usually love anything Neutrogena, I didn't have high hopes for this, I didn't think it would work for me. It gave surprising results though. It has made my skin so smooth and soft in places it's never been before. It does a good job at removing makeup except it won't completely remove waterproof mascara. It doesn't take much, so a bottle will last a while. It's a clear liquid that doesn't really have a scent and is super gentle. I need a scrub for my skin and my acne because I'm acne prone but this cleanser is a great choice.
Not a bad product I don't know how "hydrating" it was compared to another makeup remover but it did remove everything and no oil it a huge bonus to me!
I love these. Is very easy to spread and smells good like a clean scent, also is pump what makes easier to get out of the packages and makes my skin super soft.

Easy on and rinses off well for a clean fresh feeling. However, it was $3 cheaper at my local grocery store for the same product in the same size. I recommend the product but not the location of sale only due to pricing.
I love this product!! I use it everyday day to clean my face and it works great! My skin is always clean and I don't get any dryness or oily after effect!

This is one of my favorites make up remover and impuritive remover. Its so effective that you dont have to use nothing elsw after lol. I love how it feels in my face and neck all day hydratation. Plus hyaluronic ácido thats very helpfull.
I love this product it feels good on my skin and doesn't have any scent. I use the scrub from this same bottle nd color and love it too. They acid is not too harsh on skin
It was good at removing Make up and it did not smell and it had ok packaging and ingredients and texture. It is good at removing make up and other things like oil from you face.

avis.titre: it's cool that you can buy a smaller size to try on or ta...
avis.texte: very cool product, gentle, with a light and pleasant smell. it is very cool that there is a smaller size and you can try it in a small version or take it with you on a trip. I am delighted. I will buy the full size and will definitely try other products from this manufacturer
I have used this product for years. It makes my face feel clean, moisturized and ready for the day. It smells so fresh and clean and leaves your face non greasy.

This is my favorite drugstore facial cleanser. It has a fresh, clean scent and a little goes a long way. I chose this oil-free formula to clean around my lash extensions. It removes all traces of makeup and leaves my skin ready for skincare.

I love this stuff I purchased in the Neutrogena set and this is amazing. This goes from a gel to a silky foamy lather fast and I do mean fast it is so gentle and cleans all of the makeup and grit leftover on your face . The best part is it has Hyaluronic Acid in it that locks all of the moisture in right away and gives you a younger supple look firmer and feeling vibrant . # Neutrogena Hydro Boost - I recommend all of these

Neutrogena's Hydro Boost Cleansing Gel and Oil-Free Makeup Remover with Hyaluronic Acid is a dynamic duo for skincare. The cleansing gel effectively removes impurities, leaving the skin feeling refreshed and hydrated. The addition of hyaluronic acid provides a boost of moisture, making it suitable for all skin types. The makeup remover effortlessly dissolves makeup without leaving a greasy residue. Together, they create a reliable and refreshing cleansing routine, especially beneficial for those with dry or sensitive skin.
PLEASE , PLEASE , PLEASE Don't Change a thing on this . I have used so many products and then they change the product or stop making it . I hope that's not the case here ….
I use this daily in the shower and it leaves my skin feeling clean and moisturized! It is gentle enough for everyday use. The scent is not over powering.
I used this as my 2nd wash. Feels good, lathers well. My skin always felt refreshed afterwards. Does have a scent but, it was really light. Washes away easy at the sink too.

avis.titre: Effective remover but if sensitive to fragrances be cauti...
avis.texte: This is my all time favorite makeup remover. It's very gentle on the skin but is extremely effective with removing all kinds of makeup. While it does have a strong scent, it's never bothered my skin (that can be sensitive to certain products) but if you are sensitive to scent I would be cautious with it. This size is perfect for traveling, and if your worried about the size, don't, a little goes a long way when it comes to this product.
This entire line is just not for me. Something about leaves me sticky. The smell reminds me of something sitting in a plastic tube too long. I love the bright colors but not for me.

avis.titre: A lightweight, hydrating gel cleanser that effectively re...
avis.texte: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Cleansing Gel is a skincare essential! This lightweight, hydrating gel transforms into a silky lather that effectively cleanses your skin. Suitable for all skin types, this soap-free, oil-free, and paraben-free cleanser is gentle and I use it daily. Experience a burst of hydration with every cleanse and say hello to soft, smooth, and revitalized skin with Neutrogena Hydro Boost Cleansing Gel.
I use this to help take of my makeup. It works really well and doesn't strip my face and leave me dry. The consistency is like a jelly type but it glides and smooth and leaves my face soft.
I love all the Hydro boost products! The texture, scent, how effective they are and how they protect and hydrate your skin is everything you could ask for.

avis.titre: It's good quality and a nice price
avis.texte: It doesn't have a scent, the packaging is nice, it has hyaluronic acid in it, the texture is smooth, it removes makeup and cleans my face well but it has made my face a little bumpy around my forehead.
